notes.title: Patch Notes - V.0.4.2 (Closed Beta)
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Escapers![/b]
A fresh new patch has gone live for our beta playtesters. Besides the game getting closer to its release state, more exciting things are happening behind the scenes — we are preparing for launch! We’re making sure everything is in order, and once everything is set, we’ll go live with an updated Steam page and reveal the release date.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]What's New?[/b][/h1][p][b]The Puppet Show[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some lights didn’t enable in certain edge cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that occurred if players disconnected while the puzzle was active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a minor pathfinding issue where an enemy could get stuck in an idle state for a few seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [i]Stalk the Butcher[/i] achievement triggered when it shouldn’t have.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual feedback when the blue key is obtained.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Silent Stalker[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug causing stalkers to get stuck.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Into the Depths[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a delay where the platform started moving late after reaching the midpoint in Obstacle Three.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved client synchronization on the platform.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Admiral’s Gambit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new puzzle for revealing a precise strike.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Keybinding[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pressing Escape now cancels the session.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Sprint to keybinding options.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Readjusted speedrun times.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs where achievements triggered incorrectly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Environments and Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more scary encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements and bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added confirmation boxes for critical decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an in-game timer for speedrunners.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And much more! [/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be announcing the release date soon. Make sure to follow us on social media ([b]Deluded Games[/b]) so you don’t miss any updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Best regards,[/b]
The Deluded Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – V.0.4.1 (Closed Beta)
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey Escapers![/b][/p][p]This update focuses on making puzzles more fun and intuitive, fine-tuning visuals and audio, and adding small but impactful improvements to the overall escape experience.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What’s New?[/b][/h2][h3][b]Room & Puzzle Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Death Room[/b] – Puzzle fully reworked for a smoother, more engaging co-op experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Admiral’s Gambit[/b]– Improved hints and clues to better guide both players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Reunion and The Finale [/b]– Lighting, textures, and props updated for stronger atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visual & Audio Enhancements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Refined glow levels, materials, and ambient sound timing for clearer, more immersive scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced effects with improved lighting and sound impact.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Tooltip Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tooltips now recognize if you’ve already found certain items, giving smarter guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby password visibility now appears on hover.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Are You Sure?” confirmation for important in-game decisions.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Smoother multiplayer syncing for interactions and puzzle progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations in inactive puzzle areas.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Coming Soon[/b]
More fine-tuning, extra polish, and final performance passes as we prepare for our next milestone. A brand-new trailer, updated Steam page, and release marketing push are just around the corner.[/p][p]— The Deluded Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – V.0.4.0 (Closed Beta)
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Escapers![/b][/p][p]This is one of our biggest updates yet—introducing major reworks, visual upgrades, better optimizations, smarter puzzle logic, and a long list of fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Thanks again to everyone playtesting and sharing feedback—it’s shaping the game every step of the way.[/p][p][/p][h2]What’s New?[/h2][h3]Room Reworks[/h3][list][*][p]Both Puppet Show and Into The Depths have been reworked with new logic, layout improvements, and better player guidance.[/p][/*][*][p]These updates aim to tighten pacing, fix progression issues, and improve co-op clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Puzzle & Gameplay Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Numerous puzzles across the game have been tuned for better co-op behavior, clearer feedback, and smoother logic—reducing softlocks and edge cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual & Audio Enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting and ambiance in several areas have been polished, including the cave and labyrinth.[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects and visual feedback bring the environments to life.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI & Accessibility[/h3][list][*][p]Colorblind mode is now enabled by default in puzzles where colors are key.[/p][/*][*][p]We've also added a helpful voice line reminder during the loading screen to highlight new player tools.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes & Polish[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed softlocks, logic bugs, and trigger issues in multiple puzzles.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved audio sync and interaction behavior for clients in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved visual glitches in the cave, library, and spawn areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fullscreen window now resizes properly; lobby input crash fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight range increased for better exploration.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated music in early puzzles and revised confusing achievement text.[/p][/*][*][p]General performance tweaks and background optimizations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Coming Soon[/h3][p]We’re gearing up for a new Steam page, an official release trailer, and the Alpha version rollout for our playtesters. Stay tuned—it’s almost time to take the next big step. Thanks for escaping with us![/p][p]— The Deluded Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – V.0.3.43 (Closed Beta)
notes.content:
[b]Hey Escapers![/b]

A fresh update just dropped for our playtesters, bringing new environmental tweaks, puzzle improvements, and long-awaited fixes to the build.

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[h2]Haunted Manor Enhancements [/h2]
[list]
[*] New interactive objects now appear throughout the manor to boost the spooky atmosphere.
[*] Colorblind Accessibility – An optional mode now describes colors with on-screen text.
[*] Steam Achievements – All planned achievements are now unlockable—go earn them!
[/list]

[h2]Room & Puzzle Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Several puzzles have been updated with new logic and behavior.
[*] Sound-based interactions have been added to key rooms for a more reactive experience.
[*] Enemy AI and movement have been refined for smoother gameplay.
[*] A soft lock issue in one puzzle has been fixed.
[*] Camera improvements now support better visibility when playing in co-op.
[/list]

[h2]Performance & Polish[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced shadow rendering load for better performance inside the house.
[*] General code optimizations and backend improvements.
[/list]

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
[list]
[*] More ambient interactions and haunted effects.
[*] Continued puzzle balancing, performance tweaks, and polish.
[/list]

Thanks for escaping with us—and a big shoutout to all our playtesters helping shape the experience!

— The Deluded Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – V.0.3.42 (Closed Beta)
notes.content:
[b]Hey Escapers![/b]

A major update has just landed for our playtesters, and with it—The Finale room is now live, making the full game playable for the first time!

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Room: The Finale – Complete the full escape experience.
[*] Voice Chat Improvements – Better proximity chat and mic selection.
[*] UI & UX Updates – Radial menu tweaks, credits added, and friend filtering in server browser.
[*] Environmental Enhancements – Spookier visuals, flashlight adjustments, and immersive new sounds.
[*] Improved Saving System – Progress is now saved more reliably.
[/list]

[h2]Room & Puzzle Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Death Room – Added a shortcut to speed up the ending phase.
[*] Battleship Room – Puzzle difficulty rebalanced.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Polish[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed Steam name display issues.
[*] Resolved indoor rain bugs and various UI problems.
[*] Plus plenty of small fixes and behind-the-scenes improvements.
[/list]

[h3]Coming Soon
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies that react to player sound.
[*] More playtesting, puzzle balancing, and overall polish.
[/list]

Thanks for escaping with us!

— The Deluded Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes – V.25.02.0 (Closed Beta)
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

A new major update has arrived for our playtesters, bringing two brand-new rooms, enhanced co-op mechanics, and immersive new features. As we move closer to finalizing the game, we’ve made several key improvements to gameplay, atmosphere, and interactivity.

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

[h2]Two New Rooms![/h2]
[list]
[*] Room 13 – Admiral’s Gambit (Now available!)
[*] Room 14 – The Reunion (Now available!)
[/list]
These new challenges introduce fresh mechanics, teamwork elements, and intense moments for you to discover!

[h2]Improved Co-op & Puzzle Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted certain puzzles to encourage teamwork and increase challenge variety.
[*] Textures, lighting, and visibility in key areas have been enhanced for a smoother, more immersive experience.
[*] We’ve expanded some locations and added more environmental interactions.
[/list]

[h2]Voice Lines & Walkie-Talkies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can now use voice lines.
[*] Walkie-talkies now visually appear when speaking!
[/list]

[h2]Audio & Atmosphere Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New sound effects have been added to increase tension and immersion.
[*] Some interactions now have improved audio feedback.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Improvements & Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Voice Chat Overhaul – We are working on adding Proximity Voice Chat and improving overall voice communication.
[*] AI & Player Sound Mechanics – Future updates will introduce enemies that react to player sounds!
[/list]

Best Regards,
The Deluded Games Team.

notes.title: Developer Update – Feb 25
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Escapers![/b]

It’s been a while since we launched our demo and participated in the October Steam Next Fest, so we wanted to share an update on our development progress. We've been working hard to finalize all 15 rooms and add even more content to make the game engaging, fun, and, of course, spooky.

We're now approaching the finish line for room development! Once all rooms are fully playable and meet our quality standards, we’ll be ready to set a release date. After that, our focus will shift entirely to polishing the game and preparing for launch to ensure the best possible experience.

Here are some of the features we’ve been working on:
[list]
[*] Proximity Voice Chat – Communicate with your team just like in a real escape room.
[*] Voice Lines – More immersive audio to enhance the atmosphere.
[*] Electrocution Controller – A shocking new gameplay element!
[*] More Encounters – Expect even more terrifying encounters.
[/list]

We're incredibly excited to bring this game to life and can’t wait to share more with you soon! We’ll be updating our Steam page and trailer in the near future. In the meantime, follow us on YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram, where we’ll soon start posting more about the game.

We’re getting closer to launch, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon!

Best regards,
Markus & Albin
Deluded Games

Electrocution Controller – A shocking new gameplay element!
More Encounters – Expect even more terrifying encounters.
